prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one production environment background plate for the Chinese xianxia idle game 尘缘问道; NOT a UI mockup or game screenshot.
Primary request: paint a serene, cold artifact-forging alcove matching the reference's refined ancient Chinese architecture, painterly realism, blue-green shadows, wet jade/stone material and distant misty mountain light. The reference is style and lighting guidance only; create a distinct intimate workshop, not a copy of the courtyard.
Scene/backdrop: dark carved timber and blue-black stone, restrained old bronze fittings, one small warm lantern near the far left edge, a lattice opening onto mist and bamboo. No characters. No weapons or artifacts in the room. No active furnace, flames, smoke, magical rays, glowing runes or piles of items.
Composition/framing: wide 2:1 landscape, intended as an opaque full-frame background behind real DOM/SVG game objects. Slightly elevated frontal three-quarter perspective. An empty low dark jade stone workbench is centered near 28 percent of the width, its quiet broad top around 70 percent of the height; leave generous clear vertical space above it for the actual selected artifact to be composited. Keep the right 45 percent spacious and subdued for live readable text and material controls, with softly articulated shadowed workshop architecture, no busy props. Keep upper and lower perimeter quiet for actual navigation and action controls.
Lighting/mood: cool soft daylight from upper left, sparse muted amber at the perimeter only, calm and unlit default workshop. The empty bench must not appear to be forging or granting anything.
Color palette: ink teal, blue-black, dark jade, muted weathered bronze; no large yellow or beige surfaces.
Text: none. No text, logos, signs, numbers, buttons, interface frames, icons or watermark.
Constraints: deliver only the finished environment illustration, no UI or artifact silhouette baked in. Preserve an open clear object area and a restrained text area. Full scene edges; no montage, no transparency.
